<div class="card-body">
'''Lift Tube''' is a [[Light]] [[Vehicle]] ([[Transport Vehicle]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">リフト・チューブ</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">4名の乗客を運べる。屋内の移動要塞の位置カードにのみ配備／移動できる。人員なしでの移動が可能。戦闘およびフォース消耗へのリアクションとして、動ける範囲で移動できる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-148o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">密閉型で、垂直水平両方向に高速で移動する輸送シリンダー。宇宙ステーションや、大型艦で主に使用されている。反重力フィールドを使用。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Lift Tube.

'''Card text:''' May carry 4 passengers. Deploy and move only at interior mobile sites. May move with no personnel aboard. May move as a react to a battle or Force drain within range.

'''Lore:''' An enclosed transport cylinder that moves fast vertically and horizontally. Used on space stations and capital ships. Uses an antigrav field.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Lift Tube]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 98. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
